description: Defines the ResourceLimits class which manages resource constraints such as maximum connections, TTL, data volume, and extensions for tenants in the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: ResourceLimits
classes.description: A class representing resource limits for tenants, including max connections, TTL, data volume, and extensions.

methods.name: setMaxConnections
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of connections supported, with validation for values >= -1.

methods.name: getMaxConnections
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum number of connections supported.

methods.name: setMaxTtl
methods.description: Sets the maximum TTL for events, with validation for values >= -1.

methods.name: getMaxTtl
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum TTL for events.

methods.name: getDataVolume
methods.description: Returns the DataVolume object associated with resource limits.

methods.name: setDataVolume
methods.description: Sets the DataVolume object for message limit verification.

methods.name: setExtensions
methods.description: Sets extension properties for resource limits.

methods.name: putExtension
methods.description: Adds or replaces an extension property by key.
